TITLE: Clarification on Access and Cost Center Changes

From: Tevuel Rinael  
To: Kesonan Mufashua  
Subject: Access Badge Series Update  
Date: March 3, 2025  

Hi Kesonan Mufashua,  

I wanted to reach out regarding a recent review of access badge series for our department. I noticed that your access badge series, DR-2125-J, has not yet been updated to reflect the recent reorganization of departmental access protocols. Since your role involves cross-functional support, I believe it’s important we ensure your access is aligned with the latest security guidelines. Could you confirm if there are any pending approvals or if we need to work with IT to expedite this?  

Thanks,  
Tevuel Rinael  

---

From: Kesonan Mufashua  
To: Tevuel Rinael  
Subject: Re: Access Badge Series Update  
Date: March 4, 2025  

Hi Tevuel Rinael,  

Thank you for the note—yes, I’ve been aware of the access badge series review. While my access badge series, DR-2125-J, has not changed, there have been updates in the way access is validated across different zones, particularly in the R&D wing. I’ve been in touch with the IT team to confirm that my current badge is still valid for all necessary areas, but I haven’t received a final confirmation yet.  

Also, I wanted to mention that there’s been a request from the finance team to review the cost center associated with my role. My current cost center is TJ-4829-H, and I believe it may need to be realigned to better reflect the scope of the current project I’m supporting. I haven’t received formal direction on this yet, but I wanted to flag it in case it overlaps with the access review you mentioned.  

Do you have any insight on whether the finance team has been coordinating with the access control team?  

Best regards,  
Kesonan Mufashua  

---

From: Tevuel Rinael  
To: Kesonan Mufashua  
Subject: Re: Access Badge Series Update  
Date: March 5, 2025  

Hi Kesonan Mufashua,  

Thanks for the clarification. I will follow up with IT to confirm the status of your access badge series, DR-2125-J, and ensure that any changes are documented. Regarding your cost center, TJ-4829-H—I don’t have visibility into the finance team’s process, but I can connect you with the finance lead if it would help streamline the discussion. Since you’ve been with the company since 2012, and I joined in 2017, I know there have been a few restructures, and it’s possible your cost center hasn’t been updated in some time.  

If you’re comfortable with it, I can help draft a brief summary of the current project scope and how it relates to the cost center change—this may help the finance team make a quicker determination. Let me know how you’d like to proceed.  

Best,  
Tevuel Rinael
